renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-next-move constellation-afterglow guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair; no extra guardian, coworker, manager, client, recipient, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one bounded result and one separated next marker covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Show only one limited work result with a broken, non-deterministic starlight interval toward an unfinished next marker; never guarantee completion, promotion, mastery or future success. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Controls and next markers remain removable, blank, open-ended or unlatched. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
